author: Yorkstralian
body:
How much ward do you have? I'm 229 and GS Benefactor as well and can clear towers. Currently have 43k ward with immortal rings, 40k if I swap one for a briny, and 37k if I swap both out, say for briny and vritra.


Still have to avoid certain fights like immortal lords, but otherwise it's doable. Start with Jinn and Buganne, cast WoO, then VSS, then evaluate. Another summon maybe, or golem fortitude, etc.

author: Livid-Bid-6453
body: It’s probably the ward. I’m 237 al 8 grand summoner trying to farm towers for the first time.  I actually just quit at the raid boss because it’s not worth losing half my shards at this point. I use phoenix pledges and very scary skeletons.

author: dreambig5
body:
For towers:

1st summon (your most beefiest that usually takes 3-4 turns to summon) as that will be instantly summoned. Then add in Ancient Jinn (for AoE effect or basically attacks all opponents). Then summon chimeras.

Not sure how many shards you have. You want to buy GSA class and celestial axe (best weapon for ward). That plus a nice Arisen shield can get you much better ward. You're in the 27k, but we need you like 90k+. If it isn't Prometheus or Oceanus, when you get to that level, just leave with your shards unless you know how to take them on. 

Lookout for Arisen Spiritgarm grimoire (an equipment that goes in your shield slot that can summon Arisen Spiritgarms). Nothren Legends: Ragnarok event. That puppy can hit 1 mil+ (not every turn to be clear) but they're nice!!!
